title: Spectre
features: Pale mist-grey hood and robe preserve the approved human-sized Wraith anatomy and cool material planes.
Eight genuine facings have plain rear hoods, grey hands joined to sleeves and a continuous drifting tail without legs or loose wisps.
Natural spectral touch and the existing targeted Life Drain have distinct full gestures; hurt and low collapsed down poses read clearly.
conceptNote: Scenario supplied the single-creature turnarounds and gesture concept. OpenAI authored all complete pixel figures, matching the primary Wraith reference.
actionsNote: Eight facings and six unique actions; the existing special alias selects the distinct Life Drain gathering clip.
cadenceNote: Spectral touch and Life Drain contact at .4 s and recover through .8 s. Rules, stats, ranges, encounter placements and FX are unchanged.
replayNote: One movement round trip, one natural touch, one real targeted Life Drain and return to ready.
contactLabel: two engine-timed spectral touch and Life Drain contacts
reviewNotes: The rejected damage draft remained upright in down cells. A fresh complete sheet supplies low collapsed robes in every facing.
Each hand remains connected to its sleeve, with no carried weapons or detached spectral fragments.
The final singleton batch completes all 31 older library appearances; separate TV/phone playtest feedback remains open on issue #272.
